correctness.rationale: The orthonormal monomial ratio is (α_i+1)_k(α_j+1)_l/(n+1)_(k+l); summing over degree-n α via the product generating function yields W_d(n;k,l)=k!l!·∏_(s=1)^(d-1)(n+k+l+s)/(k+l+d-1)!. Product coefficients are 1/((n+l+1)(n+k+l+1)), with commutator difference (k-l)/[(n+k+1)(n+l+1)(n+k+l+1)]. The sum of reciprocal binomials and n/r split imply S2 convergence for products d≤3 and commutators d≤5. The k=l=0 diagonal term diverges for product d≥4 and (k,l)=(1,0) diverges for commutator d≥6. Spectator coordinate slicing gives ||C_j||_(m)≤√(3/m), so for high-degree projection Q_N the mixed product norm is O_d(N^-1/2); finite-rank complement proves compactness for every finite d. Verify order of factors carefully using invariance of coordinate threshold projections. The checker covers finite algebra only; infinite proofs reconstructed from displayed estimates.
